relativeChromaDefinition: sqrt(sum((RGBc-Y)^2))/Y in linear sRGB, Y=.2126R+.7152G+.0722B; only Y>1e-12
endpointDefinition: linear output channel <=0 or >=1, not a count after JPEG quantization; source endpoint is decoded RGB>=1, not proof of sensor clipping
